question: Who will chair the Departmental Summit 2025 on National Ayush Mission and Capacity Building in States being held at AIIA, New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prataprao Jadhav.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Ayush will host the Departmental Summit on National Ayush Mission (NAM)__ and __Capacity Building in States__ on __3–4 September__ at __AIIA, New Delhi__, to be chaired by __Minister of State Prataprao Jadhav__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prataprao Jadhav__, Minister of State, will chair the two-day national summit.**
 
• **As chair, he will lead deliberations to strengthen __NAM__ and support __state capacity building__.**
 
• **He will steer collaboration among __States and UTs__ to promote __holistic healthcare__.**
 
• **Discussions chaired by him will draw on __NITI Aayog’s six thematic sub-groups__ covering financial management, QA of Ayush medicine, IT and more.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Ayush Mission (NAM)**__

 __
 
• The summit aims to strengthen NAM__ and its implementation across States/UTs.
 
• Aligned with promoting __holistic healthcare__.
 
 
 
• __**Capacity Building in States**__
 __
 
• Focus on improving state-level systems, workforce readiness, and implementation support.
 
• Envisions better coordination between States and UTs.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog Thematic Sub-Groups**__
 __
 
• Six themes identified to drive discussions, including financial management__, __quality assurance of Ayush medicine__, and __IT__.
 
 
 
• __**Event Details**__
 __
 
• Dates__: 3–4 September; __Venue__: __AIIA, New Delhi__.
 
• Objective: Strengthen NAM, enhance capacity, and foster inter-state collaboration.
